## 席位核对 · L1-c · REWORK (paperwork only) · head `dd26af31` · 2026-11-22T06:52Z

Read: the whole diff at `dd26af31` (merge-base `a6756a28`, 19 files, +126/-35) against `l1-review-checklist.md`; ruling 7074372050 (A 「A 改叫「事件」」); claim 7074019286; card #36148 (Done when).

**Mechanical face (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36317`): CLEAN.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36148` on line 1, no other closing keyword; changeset covers `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/components`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. At `dd26af31` there are 45 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed and 0 pending, with Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`.

**The code matches the ruling, item by item.**
- `detail.streamActivity`: zh-Hans and zh-Hant 「事件」, en `Events`, and de/es/fr/ja/ko/pt-BR/ru/ar take the eight words the ruling's execution list names.
- `detail.noActivity` 「暂无动态」/「暫無動態」; `detail.activity` 「动态」/「動態」; `activityAccessDenied`, `activityLoadFailed` and `filterActivity` say 动态. No key is added, renamed or removed, and en `noActivity` / `activity` are unchanged.
- The en chip fallback in `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx:209` follows the pack, as the ruling's execution list names.
- The remaining zh-Hans 活动 strings (`sidebar.activityFeed`, a setup subtitle, `agentActivity`) are outside the record timeline.
- The new i18n pin bans 活动/活動 from every string the stream draws and checks that the chip differs from the tab, the title and the field-history chip in every pack.
- Done when (card): the body's live hotcrm lead reading, in a zh-CN browser, shows 活动 only on hotcrm's own labels, with the stream reading 「动态 (2)」.
- No seat-1 hot file is touched (`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`).

**On the two 动态 tabs (the area's question).** After this PR, an `Activity` tab and the `Activity stream` tab both read 动态 in zh. My reading is that this can happen only on a page whose author writes both labels:
- The synthesized page writes only `Activity stream` (`synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`).
- I find no authored `Activity` page tab in `examples/**` or hotcrm. The `'Activity'` hits there are an object label (`app-crm/activity.object.ts`) and a nav group (`hotcrm src/sales/apps/crm.app.ts:401`).
- Ruling item 3 sets `detail.activity`, which covers "an authored `Activity` tab label", to 「动态」, "the same word as `detail.timeline`". The maintainer chose that equality on the card.

So this is not an escalation. It does belong in the PR body as a stated residual, under item 1 below.

**REWORK (paperwork, no code change):**
1. **Name the two files outside the claim's declared surface, in the PR body and on the claim.** Claim 7074019286's `File surface:` lists only the locale packs, the new test, the pin tests and the changeset. The diff also edits:
   - `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`: `KNOWN_LABEL_DICT` `Activity` → 动态/動態. It is the strip's second copy of the label, so it executes ruling item 3 for an authored `Activity` tab.
   - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`: the en fallback and two comments, plus comment-only edits in `recordTimelineStream.ts`.

   The report (7075355848) and the changeset mention them; the PR body says nothing about `containers.tsx`. The checklist wants the claim's file surface amended in the same round and the body to name each such edit with its reason. Add one body bullet for `containers.tsx`: why (ruling item 3, the strip's own copy) and the two-动态-tabs residual with your measurement. Post a claim amendment naming both files.

Once the body and claim amendment are in, name the head. A body-only change keeps the code read, and I read only that delta.
